summary.zh-CN: 长会话压缩恢复、大历史按需加载，并修复 Windows 会话创建与导入。
summary.en-US: Recover long conversations, load large histories on demand, and fix Windows session imports.

title.zh-CN: 保留原始历史并确认执行条件
title.en-US: Retain original history and confirm action conditions

body.zh-CN: 不完整摘要不会被当作完整历史。上下文仍可容纳时延后压缩；必须缩减时保存恢复检查点，先回读历史或明确澄清业务条件，再继续执行其它工具。
body.en-US: Incomplete summaries are not treated as complete history. Compaction can be deferred when context fits; required reductions save a recovery checkpoint and require history reads or explicit business clarification before other tools resume.

body.zh-CN: 页面、原文读取和运行缓存设有容量预算。需要重建索引时显示准备进度，可停止和重试；首次准备仍需扫描原始记录。
body.en-US: History pages, source reads and runtime caches have capacity budgets. Index rebuilding shows preparation progress with cancellation and retry; initial preparation still scans the original records.

body.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 目录同步引发的 EPERM；源记录和恢复意图文件仍执行落盘，普通文件写入错误会明确返回。0.59.2 未推广至 Runtime 通道，本版整合其长会话改进。
body.en-US: Fix EPERM from directory synchronization on Windows while retaining source and recovery-intent file flushing. Ordinary file-write errors remain visible. Version 0.59.2 was not promoted to the runtime channel; this release includes its long-conversation improvements.

body.zh-CN: 通过 stable NPM 和 runtime 通道交付。旧版不能直接继续写入使用新恢复语义的会话，回退需先由当前版本恢复成完整快照；本次不发布新的桌面安装包。
body.en-US: Ships through stable NPM and runtime channels. Older versions must not write conversations using the new recovery semantics; restore a complete snapshot with the current reader before rollback. No new desktop installers are included.
